name: gowitness - Web Screenshot at Scale
description: gowitness uses a headless Chrome to screenshot web services at scale and store the results (and page metadata/headers) in a searchable report/DB. During recon it turns a large host/URL list into a visual triage board so you quickly spot login portals, default pages, dashboards, and interesting apps.
notes:
=== INSTALL ===
  go install github.com/sensepost/gowitness@latest    # needs Chrome/Chromium

=== SCAN A LIST (v3 syntax) ===
  gowitness scan file -f <file>            # one URL/host per line
  gowitness scan single -u <url>
  gowitness scan cidr --cidr <cidr>

=== FROM NMAP/MASSCAN XML ===
  gowitness scan nmap -f scan.xml --service-contains http

=== REPORT ===
  gowitness report server                  # browse results at http://localhost:7171
  # screenshots + headers + technologies stored in gowitness.sqlite3

=== LEGACY v2 (if installed) ===
  gowitness file -f urls.txt ; gowitness report serve

=== ALTERNATIVES ===
  aquatone        # screenshot + clustering
  EyeWitness      # screenshots + categorization
  httpx -screenshot

recommended.note: aquatone clusters similar pages from the same input.
EyeWitness is a comparable screenshot/triage tool.
httprobe to build the live-URL list to screenshot.

defense.why_it_works: gowitness just loads each URL in a browser and captures the response, which is indistinguishable from a normal client visit except for volume and a predictable user-agent/timing pattern across many hosts from one source.
defense.prerequisites: A list of reachable web hosts/URLs (from subdomain/port enumeration).
defense.impact: Rapid visual mapping of the external web estate, surfacing forgotten portals, default installs, and admin panels for targeting.
defense.detection: [MITRE T1595.002] Many short-lived HTTP sessions to diverse hosts from one source in a short window; headless-Chrome user-agent; single GET per host with no asset follow-up variance; WAF/CDN bot signatures.
defense.artifacts: Web/proxy/CDN access logs showing a burst of single-page loads across many vhosts from one IP, HeadlessChrome UA, uniform timing.
defense.splunk_spl:
index=web (http_user_agent=*HeadlessChrome* OR http_user_agent=*gowitness*)
| stats dc(host) as hosts count by src_ip
| where hosts > 20
defense.sentinel_kql:
let win = 10m;
W3CIISLog
| where csUserAgent has "HeadlessChrome" or csUserAgent has "gowitness"
| summarize Hosts=dcount(csHost), Count=count() by cIP, bin(TimeGenerated, win)
| where Hosts > 20
defense.prevention: Bot management / rate limiting at the WAF/CDN; reduce external attack surface (decommission forgotten apps); require auth on admin portals and hide them from the internet; alert on headless-browser UAs sweeping many vhosts.

detections.name: Headless-browser mass web recon (gowitness/aquatone)
detections.logic:
W3CIISLog
| where csUserAgent has "HeadlessChrome" or csUserAgent has "gowitness"
| summarize Hosts=dcount(csHost), Count=count() by cIP, bin(TimeGenerated, 10m)
| where Hosts > 20
detections.tuning: Allowlist known monitoring sources; weight on external IPs and vhost breadth
